templates.name: Single Task Assignment
templates.subject: [@{outputs('Compose_Priority_Level')}] Assignment — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — @{outputs('Compose_Subject')}
templates.trigger: single-assignment module dispatches one task to one officer.

templates.name: Bulk Consolidated Dispatch
templates.subject: [Batch @{outputs('Compose_Batch_Id')}] @{outputs('Compose_Batch_Total')} matters assigned for action
templates.trigger: bulk-assignment module dispatches a consolidated batch.

templates.name: Email-to-Task Assignment
templates.subject: [@{outputs('Compose_Priority_Level')}] Email converted to task — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')}
templates.trigger: Customer-service mailbox item converted into a registry task.

templates.name: Portal Intake Alert
templates.subject: New portal submission — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} awaiting triage
templates.trigger: Document Portal SUBMISSION flow lands a new public submission in intake.

templates.name: Document Submitted for Review
templates.subject: For review — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — @{outputs('Compose_Subject')}
templates.trigger: An officer routes a document to a reviewer or unit head.

templates.name: Action Required — Overdue Escalation
templates.subject: OVERDUE — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — action required now
templates.trigger: A task passes its due date without disposal; escalation rule fires.

templates.name: Daily Task Digest
templates.subject: Your DGO digest — @{outputs('Compose_Digest_Date')} — @{outputs('Compose_Batch_Total')} open matters
templates.trigger: Scheduled daily digest per officer or unit.

templates.name: Approval / Decision Request
templates.subject: For decision — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — @{outputs('Compose_Subject')}
templates.trigger: approvals module routes a matter to a deciding authority.

templates.name: Dispatch / Transmittal Confirmation
templates.subject: Dispatched — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — transmittal @{outputs('Compose_Transmittal_Ref')}
templates.trigger: dispatch module confirms outward transmission of a document.

templates.name: Internal Support Request
templates.subject: [@{outputs('Compose_Priority_Level')}] Service desk @{outputs('Compose_Ticket_Ref')} — @{outputs('Compose_Subject')}
templates.trigger: Staff member raises an internal support request to the IT department.

templates.name: Official Correspondence (outbound letterhead)
templates.subject: @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — @{outputs('Compose_Subject')}
templates.trigger: correspondence-email module composes outbound agency correspondence. Carries all six configured variants (official correspondence, request for information, transmittal, invitation, circular, closure) through Compose_Correspondence_Type and Compose_Body_Html.

templates.name: Single Task Assignment — Email Origin
templates.subject: [@{outputs('Compose_Priority_Level')}] Assignment — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — from the email of @{outputs('Compose_Source_Sender_Name')}
templates.trigger: single-assignment module dispatches one task to one officer where that task was raised from an email received by the Agency.

templates.name: Submission Received — Acknowledgement
templates.subject: Acknowledgement of Submission — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')}
templates.trigger: SUBMISSION flow returns a minted registry reference.

templates.name: Email Verification Code
templates.subject: Your NITDA verification code
templates.trigger: VERIFY flow issues a one-time code.

templates.name: Status — Under Review
templates.subject: Under review — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')}
templates.trigger: Registry moves the record to the governed status "review".

templates.name: Action Required — Request for Information
templates.subject: Action required — information needed on @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')}
templates.trigger: Officer raises a request for information; status becomes "action-required".

templates.name: Decision Issued
templates.subject: Decision on @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — @{outputs('Compose_Decision_Label')}
templates.trigger: Unit head or DGCEO issues a decision (approved / declined).

templates.name: Matter Closed — Final Response
templates.subject: Final response — @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} now closed
templates.trigger: Registry closes and archives the record.

templates.name: Helpdesk Case Acknowledged
templates.subject: Helpdesk case @{outputs('Compose_Case_Ref')} — we have your request
templates.trigger: SUPPORT flow returns a CASE- reference.

templates.name: Acknowledgement Clock Overdue
templates.subject: Status of @{outputs('Compose_Reference_Id')} — acknowledgement now overdue
templates.trigger: Working-day acknowledgement clock passes 3 days without substantive acknowledgement.
